comment: fsd: QA passed 32 of 33 criteria and left one to a person: the brief's last-round warning. It names the derived counter and appears exactly when one more send-back makes the unit stuck, which is what the user story asks for ('so that I know a send-back would make the unit stuck'), but it reads (3/3) where the criterion's example says (2/3). With a max of 3 the fourth send-back parks the unit, so 3/3 is the last round; the Plan decides the brief gets no code change and derived counters are read through the pinned workflow like named ones, and the QA run shows the same threshold as for named counters today. The example figure in the criterion was off by one, the behaviour is the intended one.
